query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.mustmeet.list
query.sql:
select pmm.id, c.course_name, e.course_number||'.'||e.section_number as section_number, t.lastfirst as teacher, pmm.teachermessage, c.dcid as coursedcid, c.course_number, e.dcid as sectiondcid, s.dcid as studentdcid, s.lastfirst as student, pmme.id as pmmeid
from u_ptc_mustmeet pmm inner join cc d on pmm.ccid = d.id inner join sections e on d.sectionid = e.id inner join courses c on e.course_number = c.course_number inner join teachers t on e.teacher = t.id inner join students s on d.studentid = s.id left outer join u_ptc_mustmeetsections pmme on e.dcid = pmme.sectiondcid
where pmm.u_ptc5_sessionsid = :sessionid and (:recordid = '-1' or pmm.id = :recordid)
order by s.lastfirst, c.course_name, e.course_number, e.section_number

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.mustmeet.teachers.sections
query.sql:
select e.id as sectionid, c.course_name, e.course_number||'.'||e.section_number as section_number, pmme.id as pmmeid
from sections e inner join courses c on e.course_number = c.course_number inner join terms r on e.termid = r.id and e.schoolid = r.schoolid inner join sectionteacher et on e.id = et.sectionid inner join teachers t on et.teacherid = t.id inner join u_ptc5_sessions ps on e.schoolid = ps.schoolid and r.yearid = ps.yearid left outer join u_ptc_mustmeetsections pmme on ps.id = pmme.u_ptc5_sessionsid and e.dcid = pmme.sectiondcid
where t.users_dcid = :userdcid and ps.id = :sessionid
order by c.course_name, section_number

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.mustmeet.teachers.sections.enrollments
query.sql:
select e.id as sectionid, c.course_name, e.course_number||'.'||e.section_number as section_number, d.id as ccid, s.lastfirst, ps.excluded, ps.priorityonly, pmm.id as recordid, pmm.teachermessage, pmme.id as pmmeid
from sections e inner join cc d on e.id = d.sectionid inner join students s on d.studentid = s.id left outer join u_students_ptc5 ps on s.dcid = ps.studentsdcid inner join courses c on e.course_number = c.course_number left outer join u_ptc_mustmeet pmm on d.id = pmm.ccid and pmm.u_ptc5_sessionsid = :sessionid left outer join u_ptc_mustmeetsections pmme on pmme.u_ptc5_sessionsid = :sessionid and e.dcid = pmme.sectiondcid
where e.id in (:sectionids)
order by c.course_name, section_number, s.lastfirst

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.mustmeet.sections
query.sql:
select pmme.id, pmme.sectiondcid, c.course_name, e.course_number||'.'||e.section_number as section_number, t.lastfirst, pmme.message, c.dcid as coursedcid, c.course_number, r.name as term
from u_ptc_mustmeetsections pmme inner join sections e on pmme.sectiondcid = e.dcid inner join terms r on e.termid = r.id and e.schoolid = r.schoolid inner join courses c on e.course_number = c.course_number inner join teachers t on e.teacher = t.id
where pmme.u_ptc5_sessionsid = :sessionid and (:recordid = '-1' or pmme.id = :recordid)
order by 3

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.mustmeet.psqueryfix
query.sql:
select id
from u_ptc_mustmeet
where ccid = :ccid and u_ptc5_sessionsid = :sessionid
